personal_info.summary: My name is Piero, and I am a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester specializing in manual testing, with experience in validating web applications and e-commerce platforms. My main focus is to ensure that products are intuitive, functional, and of high quality for end users. I am passionate about learning new testing methodologies and tools, and I enjoy applying my knowledge to improve user experience and help teams achieve their quality goals.
